import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'survived': [0, 1, 1, 1, 0],
    'pclass': [3, 1, 3, 1, 3],
    'sex': ['male', 'female', 'female', 'female', 'male'],
    'age': [22.0, 38.0, 26.0, 35.0, 35.0],
    'sibsp': [1, 1, 0, 1, 0],
    'parch': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'fare': [7.25, 71.2833, 7.925, 53.1, 8.05],
    'embarked': ['S', 'C', 'S', 'S', 'S'],
    'class': ['Third', 'First', 'Third', 'First', 'Third'],
    'who': ['man', 'woman', 'woman', 'woman', 'man'],
    'adult_male': [True, False, False, False, True],
    'deck': ['', 'C', '', 'C', ''],
    'embark_town': ['Southampton', 'Cherbourg', 'Southampton', 'Southampton', 'Southampton'],
    'alive': ['no', 'yes', 'yes', 'yes', 'no'],
    'alone': [False, False, True, False, True]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set up the visualization
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Data Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Survival by class and sex
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
survival_data = df.groupby(['class', 'sex', 'alive']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
survival_data.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71'])
ax1.set_title('Survival by Class and Sex')
ax1.set_xlabel('Class & Sex')
ax1.set_ylabel('Count')
ax1.legend(title='Survived')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Age distribution by survival
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
for survived_status in df['alive'].unique():
    subset = df[df['alive'] == survived_status]['age']
    color = '#2ecc71' if survived_status == 'yes' else '#e74c3c'
    sns.kdeplot(data=subset, ax=ax2, label=f'Survived: {survived_status}', 
                fill=True, alpha=0.5, color=color)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age')
ax2.set_ylabel('Density')
ax2.legend()

# 3. Fare distribution by class
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
class_order = ['First', 'Third']
box_data = [df[df['class'] == cls]['fare'] for cls in class_order]
box_plot = ax3.boxplot(box_data, labels=class_order, patch_artist=True)
colors = ['#3498db', '#e67e22']
for patch, color in zip(box_plot['boxes'], colors):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
ax3.set_title('Fare Distribution by Class')
ax3.set_ylabel('Fare')
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 4. Embarkation points
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
embark_counts = df['embark_town'].value_counts()
colors = ['#9b59b6', '#1abc9c', '#f1c40f']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(embark_counts.values, labels=embark_counts.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax4.set_title('Passengers by Embarkation Town')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 5. Family relationships
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
family_data = df[['sibsp', 'parch', 'alone']].copy()
family_data['family_size'] = family_data['sibsp'] + family_data['parch'] + 1
family_summary = family_data.groupby('alone')['family_size'].agg(['mean', 'std'])
x = np.arange(len(family_summary.index))
width = 0.35
bars1 = ax5.bar(x - width/2, family_summary['mean'], width, label='Mean', 
                color='#34495e', yerr=family_summary['std'], capsize=5)
ax5.set_xlabel('Traveling Alone')
ax5.set_ylabel('Family Size')
ax5.set_title('Family Size Analysis')
ax5.set_xticks(x)
ax5.set_xticklabels(['With Family', 'Alone'])
ax5.legend()
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 6. Survival correlation matrix
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
numeric_cols = ['survived', 'pclass', 'age', 'sibsp', 'parch', 'fare']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(corr_matrix, dtype=bool))
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, mask=mask, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', 
            center=0, square=True, linewidths=1, ax=ax6, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8})
ax6.set_title('Correlation Matrix')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
